description: Reconstructed and incomplete sample accountability bundle based on repository records. Not an audited financial claim.
importInstructions: POST each event in order to /api/accountability/events or /system/accountability/events.

payload.title: Reconstructed Copilot accountability example
payload.verbatimOriginalDirective: Build a first-class Copilot/accountability tracking app inside AxAxiAxes/keystone-eternal-seed.
payload.requestedDeliverable: A directive-vs-delivery audit ledger with evidence, deviation, ratings, and loss tracking.
constraints: Do not treat planning, documentation, a commit, or a pull request as successful completion.
Use human-confirmed fields for money and hours.
dependencies: Existing AXIOM engine and AXES web UI
Repository-controlled evidence only unless a human confirms more
payload.definitionOfDone: A founder can preserve a detailed directive verbatim, compare it against delivery, and prevent unsupported verified success claims.

subrequirements.text: Store the founder's exact original directive verbatim.
Show founder direction, interpretation, actual delivery, evidence, deviation, and outcome together.
Never allow verified success without explicit evidence and human confirmation.
Keep founder-confirmed hours separate from assistant/session elapsed time.

payload.amendmentText: Capture detailed directions instead of flattening them, and preserve superseded instructions with timestamps.

subrequirementsAdded.text: Preserve amendments and superseded instructions with timestamps and source references.

constraintsAdded: Do not invent invoices, cloud bills, domain costs, or hours.

payload.interpretation: Build an append-only ledger plus a dedicated admin-gated comparison UI inside the existing AXIOM/AXES experience.

checklistMapping.interpretation: Expose dedicated routes, filters, dashboard metrics, and Markdown/JSON reports.

payload.summary: Repository changes added a new accountability ledger service, web UI, tests, and documentation.

payload.explanation: The accountability app was built locally in the repository, but the broader deployment/integration path remained incomplete.

deviations.description: Historical work previously used stale default-branch assumptions before the repository default branch was corrected.
Some earlier work treated documentation, PR activity, or repository artifacts as stronger outcome proof than the evidence supported.

payload.explanation: The Docker teardown fix was locally validated, but the deployment/integration path remained incomplete and the chat outage/502 remained unresolved in production.

payload.notes: Founder-provided negative rating preserved exactly as a rating, not as a legal or financial conclusion.
Estimated exposure based on recorded assistant/session elapsed time examples only. This is explicitly not a claim that all of that time equals confirmed founder labor.
